decision_rationale: The paper applies an unmodified pretrained PLM (ESM-2) to variant-effect scoring rather than presenting a new generative model. It does provide foundation-model-like evidence via a 3B-parameter pretrained PLM with broad applicability to protein sequences.
evidence_snippet: "unmodified pretrained PLM"; "ESM-2 three billion parameter variant"; "broadly useful for variant-effect prediction"
